summary: Laser-focused retest of the two HIGH frontend bugs from iteration_6 plus the new PDP-404 backend change. BOTH FIXES NOW VERIFIED IN THE REAL UI. FIX #1: Admin.jsx:450 ALL_STATUSES read directly from the DOM — per-order select[data-testid^='status-select-'] options = ['Pending','Accepted','Preparing','Packed','Ready','Out For Delivery','Delivered','Cancelled'] and the top filter select = ['All', + same 8]; selecting 'Accepted' on order 6a68d14181f39653bc4e5aa3 fired PATCH /api/admin/orders/<id>/status (200), toast 'Marked Accepted', select value persisted as 'Accepted' after reload. FIX #2: setApproval now defined (Admin.jsx:222); no ESLint no-undef remains. Flipped test-vendor-ui-tomato to approval_status='pending' via API, then clicking [data-testid='approve-product-test-vendor-ui-tomato'] fired PATCH /api/admin/products/6a68cddb2d6830a591905de8/approval, showed 'Product approved' toast, and the reloaded row (sourced from GET /api/admin/products) shows badge 'approved'; Reject click flipped it to 'rejected' and Approve flipped it back to 'approved' — full round trip confirmed against the DB-backed list. MINOR BACKEND fix verified: GET /api/products/<slug> now returns 404 for pending and rejected, 200 (no _id) for approved. Sanity: full backend suite 103/103 pass (49+36+8+10 new); OrderDetail for order #4E5AA3 still reconciles Subtotal Rs.65 + Delivery Rs.30 - Coupon (WELCOME10) Rs.6.50 = Rs.88.50 with the 8-step tracker and 'Accepted' active.

minor.issue: Still raw dict payloads instead of Pydantic models (carried over from iteration_5/6).

Still no brute-force lockout / rate limiting on repeated failed logins (playbook item 4). App uses JWT in localStorage (not httpOnly cookies), so the cookie/CORS-credential playbook items do not apply.

issues: Carried over: the 'Reject' pill still renders on every already-approved row (22/22), making the destructive action the most prominent control; consider showing it only for pending rows or behind a menu.

When an order's status is moved backwards (e.g. Delivered -> Accepted), the later steps still display their stale historical timestamps while their circles are unfilled, which reads as contradictory. Low priority.

Console warning: a stale order-item image with src 'http://x/y.jpg' triggers Mixed Content + ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED. Comes from old TEST_ order seed data, not product data (all product images are https). Cosmetic.
